fields.title: Unlock Affordable Rentals & Property Listings – KRH-Finder Launch Offer!
fields.content:
Looking for a vacant house near you? Are you a landlord ready to reach tenants faster?
KRH-Finder is your one-stop solution – and it’s now more affordable than ever!

Limited-Time Offer: August 1st – August 31st, 2025.
Enjoy exclusive discounts before the new prices roll out in September!

Landlord Packages – Promote Your Property Easily.
Basic – Only Ksh. 400/month: List 1 property.

Standard – Ksh. 1,000/month: List up to 3 properties.

Premium – Ksh. 2,000/month: List up to 7 properties.

Tenant Benefits – Find Vacant Houses Fast.
Unlock landlord contacts for just Ksh. 10.

Get real-time suggestion popups of vacant houses within 2km radius of your location.
(Simply log in and enable location services in your browser).

Don't miss this opportunity to connect, search, and save.
Join KRH-Finder today – offer ends August 31st!

The living areas are open and airy, offering the perfect blend of modern design and traditional comfort.
